question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom/phrase in the given sentence.**

Henry said he would help with the rent, but he __**left me in the lurch**.__
solution:
The correct answer is "To desert someone."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"left me in the lurch"** means to abandon or leave someone in a difficult or challenging situation, especially when they were relying on you for help or support. (किसी को कठिन या चुनौतीपूर्ण स्थिति में छोड़ना या छोड़ देना, खासकर जब वे मदद या समर्थन के लिए आप पर भरोसा कर रहे हों)

 
 
• **Example**: *She promised to help me with the project but **left me in the lurch**__ at the last minute.*
 
 
 
• It implies that the person who was supposed to provide assistance or fulfill a commitment unexpectedly failed to do so, leaving the other person stranded or in a predicament.

Therefore, correct answer is Option 3.
